categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Recodeal Interconnect System Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of connector products. Its main product lines include connectors, connector components, and modules, covering electric, optical, microwave, fluid, and data connectors. The company serves industries such as new energy vehicles, energy storage, communication, industrial rail transit, robotics, and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes innovation-driven development with core technologies in high-voltage large-current connectors, battery swapping connectors, intelligent networked vehicle connectors, 5G board-to-board RF connectors, liquid cooling supercharging technology, and high-speed copper cable technology for data centers. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including mold design and manufacturing, precision injection molding, stamping, mechanical processing, and automated assembly, supported by integrated IT systems like PLM, ERP, MES, and QMS for agile and flexible production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global and domestic enterprises in new energy vehicles (e.g., BYD, NIO, XPeng, Li Auto, Changan), communication equipment manufacturers (e.g., ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Samsung), and industrial sectors such as robotics, medical devices, and rail transit. The company’s products are widely used in electric vehicles, charging infrastructure, 5G and 6G communication networks, AI and data centers, and emerging fields like humanoid robots and low-altitude aircraft.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production bases in Suzhou, Taizhou, and Mianyang, and has expanded internationally with factories in the United States and Mexico. It has established offices in the US and Germany and is preparing for production layouts in Europe and Southeast Asia, aiming to increase its global market share and serve international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Recodeal operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of connectors and related components. It integrates upstream processes such as mold design and raw material processing with downstream activities including product assembly and direct sales to OEMs and system integrators, providing comprehensive connector system solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on dual leadership in market and technology, emphasizing continuous R&D investment in new energy vehicles, communication (5G, 6G, AI, data centers), industrial applications, and emerging sectors like robotics and low-altitude economy. It pursues innovation in high-performance connectors, liquid cooling charging systems, integrated battery management, and advanced materials, supported by expanding its R&D team and collaborating with universities and industry partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized connector products and integrated connector system solutions to OEMs and industrial clients. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributor channels for smaller customers, with revenues recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Recodeal is positioned as a leading domestic connector manufacturer with international competitiveness, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise. It competes with global giants like Amphenol and TE Connectivity, leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio and innovation capabilities to break foreign monopolies in communication and new energy vehicle connectors. The company holds significant market share in China and is expanding globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.41 billion, a 55.29% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 175 million, up 28.11%. Total assets grew 26.56% to RMB 4.32 billion, with net assets increasing 7.82% to RMB 2.10 billion. The company’s R&D investment rose 26.91% to RMB 147 million, supporting sustained growth and international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Recodeal emphasizes high-performance, high-reliability, and integrated connector solutions tailored to customer needs across multiple industries. Its unique value lies in comprehensive product lines spanning electric, optical, microwave, fluid, and data connectors, advanced liquid cooling charging technologies, and rapid innovation cycles. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, quality assurance systems, and agile manufacturing enable it to deliver customized, cost-effective solutions that enhance customer product performance and competitiveness.
